interpretation: Every declared account is retained. Incomplete accounts have no profitability comparison; their observed fold prefixes remain explicitly labeled.
Matched references share currency, starting cash, proportional costs, first and last evaluation sessions. Rules also share holding period.
Cost changes alter eligibility and sizing; higher-cost outcomes are not assumed to decrease monotonically.
Cash-heavy means average invested fraction below 10%, a descriptive analysis threshold. A 30% observed drawdown screen is not an enforced future loss cap.
Calendar-year and fold summaries include partial terminal intervals. Positive counts use strictly greater than zero.
Pooled MSE and repeated account comparisons are descriptive, not independent tests or significance. Historical best rows remain exploratory.
Current-member and adjusted-vintage biases remain. Proportional costs omit fixed brokerage charges, FX, subscription, taxes and contributions.
Profit concentration retains only saved top/bottom symbols; it does not establish a complete per-symbol attribution.
No model training, study execution, new data access, broker calls or main-result mutation is performed by this script.
